title: The Frontier Lord and the Girl with the Blue Horn
overview: Dias is awarded a domain for his wartime service, but there's one small problem. Does anyone even live there?

title: The Frontier Lord and His First Visitor
overview: Dias settles into daily life with Alna, and little by little, people begin to come calling.

title: The Frontier Lord and the Strange Merchant
overview: The population of Nezrose slowly grows, including a few surprises courtesy of an unusual visitor.

title: The Frontier Lord and the Neighboring Lord
overview: Dias meets the new lord of the neighboring domain, and he learns there are many rumors about them both.

title: The Frontier Lord and the Assailants from the Desert
overview: Dias tries his hand at farming, and Eldan sends a caravan of gifts to help him establish his domain.

title: The Frontier Lord and the Twins' Prayer
overview: Senai and Ayhan want to secretly help Dias cultivate his field. Can a new arrival offer them a solution?

title: The Frontier Lord and the New Subjects
overview: Expectations are low for a new group of dogkin immigrants, but Dias has some ideas for how they'd be useful.

title: The Frontier Lord and the Grassland Battle
overview: Diane's plans quickly go awry when she launches an attack on Dias in his own domain.

title: The Frontier Lord and the Wedding
overview: Klaus and Canis have grown close, and an event must be held, even if Dias is oblivious.

title: The Frontier Lord and His Son and Daughters
overview: A bunch of new faces arrive at Iluk Village, but not many of them turn out to be total strangers.

title: The Frontier Lord and Alna's Big Brother
overview: Zorg rushes home to save his sister Alna from the wicked domain lord, utterly unprepared for what awaits him.
